# Every model, scored separately (generated by evaluate_all.py)

Same split, fees, V3 policy and exposure cap as `backend/playoff.py`. Lower Brier / log loss is better. VALIDATION ONLY: the test set is not scored here (it is opened once, for the winner). Per-row q / lo / hi for every member: `q_validation.csv.gz`.
